# E0251: a published version's lens was changed

A version's lenses are part of it: an instance translated through the
published lens would translate differently through a changed one. Here the
candidate's 1.0 keeps its schema, but its ForwardLens writes a different
placeholder. The schema's identity is unchanged and its lenses' is not.

## Example

`candidate/ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
}
```

`candidate/ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
	size: int
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		size: 0
	}
	lacunas: {
		size: [{
			type:    Placeholder
			message: "0 is a placeholder"
		}]
	}
}
```

`published/ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
}
```

`published/ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
	size: int
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		size: -1
	}
	lacunas: {
		size: [{
			type:    Placeholder
			message: "-1 is a placeholder"
		}]
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0251]: the ForwardLens in history/1.0.thema is not as published
 --> history/1.0.thema:6:1
  |
6 | ForwardLens: {
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^
  |
  = note: a version's lenses are part of it: instances already translated through the published lens would translate differently
  = help: restore the ForwardLens in history/1.0.thema as it was published
```
